kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنحسم (form VII)
# أَنْحَسِمُ (ʔanḥasimu) /ʔan.ħa.si.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# أَنْحَسِمَ (ʔanḥasima) /ʔan.ħa.si.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
# أَنْحَسِمْ (ʔanḥasim) /ʔan.ħa.sim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَسَمَ (inḥasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
